changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionCondition') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] ( [AssetVersionUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [MatchType] [int] NOT NULL, [Position] [int] NOT NULL, [Threshold] [float] NULL, [Weight] [decimal](5, 3) NULL ) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.rollback:
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricAssetVersionCondition_AssetVersionUid') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAssetVersionCondition_AssetVersionUid] end
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricAssetVersionCondition_Uid') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAssetVersionCondition_Uid] end
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricAssetVersionCondition_MatchType') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAssetVersionCondition_MatchType] end
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricAssetVersionCondition_Position') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAssetVersionCondition_Position] end
if exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionCondition_MetricAssetVersion') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionCondition_MetricAssetVersion] end
if exists (select 1 from [sys].[key_constraints] where name = 'PK_MetricAssetVersionCondition') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] DROP CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricAssetVersionCondition] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_MetricsAssetVersionCondition') begin CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX [CIX_MetricsAssetVersionCondition] ON [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] ( [AssetVersionUid] ASC, [Position] ASC ) end
changeSet.rollback: if exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_MetricsAssetVersionCondition') begin DROP INDEX [CIX_MetricsAssetVersionCondition] ON [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end
